description: Free, no key, instant result. Without api_key: 5 own checks per client address per UTC day, shared by check_book and the finance tools; samples are never counted. A free key (get_free_key, no card, no e-mail) runs 20 own checks a day and 200 in all. Try it now: call with no arguments, or with sample=true, to run the published sample (made-up figures, no key, never counted against the caps) and see real flags; the result ends with next, the fields to send for your own data. Send quote or pricing sheet lines as JSON; returns flags for mismatched line totals, wrong discount amounts, subtotal and grand-total errors, and tier range conflicts (overlap and gap). Math only. Process-and-discard: nothing is stored or logged after the run. A request containing a Luhn-valid card number or a valid IBAN is refused before accept with reason sensitive_data_refused (not counted as a check). Desk: volume use. Top-level verdict is CLEAN, FLAGGED or NOT_VERIFIED.

api_key.description: Optional key (vdk_...). Same as the Bearer header.

currency.description: Optional currency code (e.g. GBP). Carried through but not used in arithmetic checks.

discount.description: Optional discount block: rate_pct (number, 0-100), base (string label, e.g. 'subtotal'), amount (number).

lines.description: Required for your own data: quote lines. Each line needs line_id, qty, unit_price and line_total.

sample.description: true runs the published sample (made-up figures) instead of your data; a call with no arguments does the same. Never counted against the caps.

subtotal.description: Optional stated subtotal; checked against sum of line totals.

tiers.description: Optional quantity tiers. Each tier needs min_qty (int), max_qty (int or null), unit_price (number). Checked for overlaps and gaps.

total.description: Optional stated total after discount; checked against subtotal minus discount.
